title: 第11章 无怨无悔
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
青云宗外门。

    九区六十九号院。

    入得客厅，齐云溪轻轻关门，透过越来越小的门缝瞧见院子里的人都往这边瞄，不禁脸颊发烫，心跳也跟着奔跑起来。

    她连忙往门上布了个隔绝禁制，暗自呼了口气，又担心被苏牧看出自己异状，不敢对视，匆匆一瞥招呼入座，然后便自顾忙碌起来。

    ——煮水泡茶，取出灵果、蜜饯等吃食装盘，将物品摆回本该所在的位置……

    苏牧坐在桌前，环视打量室内环境。

    说是客厅，也不过比修炼石室略大一点，只有十来平的面积。

    相比他自己住所的单调，此处倒显得非常充实，添置了许多物什。

    碗橱、简易鞋架、梳妆台、熏香炉、窗台上还放了一盆兰花……狭小的空间被充斥得满满当当，却又归置得整洁有序，不给人拥挤感。

    一景一物，尽显生活气息。

    少顷，齐云溪烧好水，泡好茶倒了两杯，热气腾腾，茶香四溢。

    “师兄喝茶。”

    她正要入座，又转身快步进去修炼室，没一会出来，将一个檀木锦盒放到苏牧面前：“突破贺礼。”

    苏牧拿起盒子当场打开，里边放着一串珠链，一共九颗龙眼大小的珠子串在一起，咋一看是黑色的，仔细瞧方才注意到内部有暗红色块晕染，珠子表面不尽相同，有的光滑如镜，有的附着有不规则纹理，但通体却晶莹剔透，闪烁着幽冷光泽。

    他目露异色，一时辨别不出珠子是出于何种玉石材质，遂将手链拿起，入手冰凉，一股清晰的凉意竟透入体内，直让精神一震，顿时心惊。

    齐云溪注意着他的表情，睫毛颤动道：“这是【凤血黑晶玉】制成的，可助益体内元气运行顺畅，气血活跃，主要用途是缓解神识疲劳，凝神静心。”

    “凤血黑晶玉？”苏牧目光一闪，从未听过，但听名字就感觉不一般。

    齐云溪轻轻点头道：“具体我也不太清楚，祖爷爷在藏经阁翻了许多古籍资料，也没找到确切的信息，只说应该是叫这个名字。”

    苏牧暗自运转功法尝试，边问：“这手链哪来的？”

    “祖爷爷说是祖传下来的。”齐云溪端起杯子又放下，接着道：“祖爷爷三灵根下品资质，能一路修到筑基后期，这手链起了很大作用，不过，师兄平时别戴在手上，修炼的时候再戴，免得给人注意到。”

    简单一番尝试，苏牧内心掀起了波澜，效果远胜对方只言片语的描述。

    他不自觉吸了口气，将手链递还回去道：“太贵重了，你自己留着用。”

    齐云溪唇角浮现浅浅的笑意，说道：“放我这太浪费了，体现不了它的价值，我踏入修行后，祖爷爷便将这手链给我了，用了这么多年，境界也没上去。”

    苏牧看出那笑容中的一丝苦涩，以前就奇怪对方为何进境这么慢，如今得知手链的存在，越发觉得不可思议。
content_en:
The outer gate of Qingyun Sect.

    Courtyard No. 69, District 9.

    After entering the living room, Qi Yunxi closed the door gently. Through the increasingly smaller cracks in the door, he saw people in the yard looking this way. His cheeks felt hot and his heartbeat started to race.

    She quickly put an isolation barrier on the door and breathed out secretly. She was worried that Su Mu would see something strange about her, so she didn't dare to look at her. She glanced at her briefly to say hello to her, and then started busy herself.

    —— Boil water to make tea, take out spiritual fruits, candied fruits and other food and put them on plates, and put the items back where they should be...

    Su Mu sat at the table and looked around the indoor environment.

    Called the living room, it is only slightly larger than the cultivation stone room, with an area of ​​only about ten square meters.

    Compared to the monotony of his own residence, this place seemed very substantial, with many additions.

    There are cupboards, simple shoe racks, dressing tables, incense burners, and a pot of orchids on the windowsill... The small space is filled to the brim, but it is arranged neatly and orderly without giving people a feeling of crowding.

    Every scene and thing shows the breath of life.

    After a while, Qi Yunxi boiled water, brewed tea and poured two cups of it. The steam was steaming and the aroma of tea overflowed.

    "Brother, drink tea."

    Just as she was about to take a seat, she turned around and hurried into the practice room. After a while, she came out and placed a sandalwood brocade box in front of Su Mu: "Breakthrough gift."

    Su Mu picked up the box and opened it on the spot. There was a bead chain inside, with a total of nine longan-sized beads strung together. At first glance, they were black, but upon closer inspection, they noticed that there were dark red patches inside. The beads had different surfaces, some were as smooth as mirrors, and some had irregular textures attached to them, but the whole body was crystal clear and shimmering with a cold luster.

    His eyes were strange, and he couldn't tell what kind of jade material the beads were made of, so he picked up the bracelet and held it cold. A clear coolness penetrated into his body, which shocked his spirit and made him feel frightened.

    Qi Yunxi paid attention to his expression, her eyelashes trembled and said: "This is made of [Phoenix Blood Black Crystal Jade], which can help the body's vitality flow smoothly and activate the blood. Its main purpose is to relieve mental fatigue and calm the mind."

    "Phoenix blood black crystal jade?" Su Mu's eyes flashed. He had never heard of it before, but when he heard the name, he felt it was unusual.

    Qi Yunxi nodded lightly and said: "I don't know the specifics. Grandpa looked through many ancient books and materials in the Sutra Pavilion, but couldn't find the exact information. He only said that it should be called this name."

    Su Mu secretly tried the exercises and asked, "Where did this bracelet come from?"

    "Grandpa Grandpa said it was passed down from our ancestors." Qi Yunxi picked up the cup and put it down, then continued: "Grandpa Grandpa has a low-grade qualification of the Three Spiritual Roots and can cultivate all the way to the late stage of foundation building. This bracelet plays a big role. However, senior brother, don't wear it on your hands at ordinary times. Wear it when you are practicing, so as not to be noticed."

    After a simple try, Su Mu's heart was stirred up, and the effect was far better than the other party's mere description.

    He took a breath unconsciously, handed the bracelet back and said, "It's too valuable, keep it for yourself."

    A faint smile appeared on Qi Yunxi's lips, and he said: "It would be too wasteful to let me go, and it cannot reflect its value. After I started practicing, my grandfather gave me this bracelet. After using it for so many years, my state has not improved."

    Su Mu saw a trace of bitterness in that smile. He used to wonder why the other party entered the country so slowly, but now that he learned about the existence of the bracelet, he found it even more incredible.
